lessons.title: Cellular Respiration & Energy Transfer
lessons.description: Model aerobic cellular respiration as chemical bond breaking and molecular rearrangement, tracking matter flow and net energy transfer to ATP.

lessons.title: Homeostasis & Thermoregulation
lessons.description: Investigate negative feedback mechanisms and model human thermoregulation via hypothalamus control, sweating, and vasoconstriction.

lessons.title: Osmoregulation & Water Balance
lessons.description: Analyze kidney response and antidiuretic hormone (ADH) signaling in maintaining blood solute concentration and cellular water balance.

lessons.title: Blood Glucose & Hormone Signaling
lessons.description: Model the insulin-glucagon antagonistic seesaw controlling glycogen storage in the liver and muscles, and explore diabetic system disruption.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Homeostasis Review
lessons.description: Comprehensive Unit 1 review synthesizing cellular energy transfer, feedback loops, and physiological data analysis with worked practice problems.

lessons.title: Photosynthesis
lessons.description: Find out where a giant kelp's mass and energy come from, test the idea with van Helmont's willow, and follow one carbon atom into sugar.

lessons.title: The Carbon Cycle
lessons.description: Track the carbon people add to the air through four spheres, find where the missing half goes, and model what a cut in emissions does.

lessons.title: Unit 2a Carbon Review
lessons.description: Quick checks, a main-ideas digest and two new practice problems for Unit 2a, using a year of carbon dioxide readings from Mauna Loa, Alaska and the South Pole.

lessons.title: Biodiversity Loss in Singapore
lessons.description: Read 200 years of Singapore extinction data, link each wave of losses to forest clearing, and start a design that protects one threatened species.

lessons.title: Richness, Evenness & Islands
lessons.description: Measure biodiversity with species richness and evenness, test reef resilience against a disease, and revise an explanation with new pond data.

lessons.title: Gut Biodiversity at Three Scales
lessons.description: Compare the gut bacteria of Hadza hunter-gatherers and city adults, follow one course of antibiotics, and see how losses build up over four generations of mice.

lessons.title: Energy and Trophic Levels
lessons.description: Calculate how much energy passes up a food chain, follow 1,000 units of energy in a simulation, and compare upright and upside-down pyramids.

lessons.title: Biosphere 2
lessons.description: Track the oxygen and carbon in a sealed ecosystem, find where the missing carbon went, and explain why its crew went hungry.

lessons.title: Polar Bears and Carrying Capacity
lessons.description: Measure how long Hudson Bay's polar bears fast on land, compare the ice and population records, and model how the ice sets their carrying capacity.

lessons.title: Orangutans and Scale
lessons.description: Turn density into a head count, find out why most of Borneo's lost orangutans died in standing forest, and compare carrying capacity at three scales.

lessons.title: Unit 2b Ecology Review
lessons.description: Quick checks, a main-ideas digest and two new practice problems for Unit 2b, then a step-by-step guide to refining your conservation design into Version 2.0.
